premise: Fox is too loud to hear anything; Rabbit teaches him to stop and listen, and they hear Owl's soft good evening.
inspiration: The folk listening game, turned against the fable of the fast one: the gift Fox lacks is not speed but quiet, and the forest answers when he finds it.
lesson: Listening lets the world talk to you.

en-US.title: Fox Learns to Listen
en-US.text: Along trotted {fox:enter} Fox, and Fox was never quiet. {fox:hop x2} He ran, he jumped, he shouted: {fox:face happy} [excited] HELLO, FOREST! And the forest said… nothing at all. {fox:face sad} [sad] Why doesn't anyone talk to me? {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came hopping and sat down in the grass. [whispers] Watch, he said. {rabbit:live} His ears shot up. He listened, very still… then he nibbled a clover leaf. {rabbit:face happy} Now you try. {canvas:sunset 0.6 35s} {fox:face normal} So Fox sat. {fox:live hold} He pricked up his ears, closed his eyes, and listened. [slowly] {sfx:leaves} A leaf rustled. {rabbit:pulse} {sfx:brook} A brook bubbled. Then, softly, {owl:enter} Owl flew down onto a branch of the old tree. {owl:live} He blinked, looked around, gave a big yawn… nodded off… then opened one eye, then both. {sfx:hoo} Hoo-hoo, he said. Good evening. {fox:live resume} Fox opened his eyes with a smile and swished his tail. {fox:face happy} {fox:hearts} [happily] The forest had been talking all along.

es-ES.title: Zorro aprende a escuchar
es-ES.text: Llegó trotando {fox:enter} Zorro, y Zorro nunca estaba callado. {fox:hop x2} Corría, saltaba, gritaba: {fox:face happy} [excited] ¡HOLA, BOSQUE! Y el bosque no decía… nada de nada. {fox:face sad} [sad] ¿Por qué nadie me habla? {rabbit:enter} Conejo llegó dando saltos y se sentó en la hierba. [whispers] Mira, le dijo. {rabbit:live} Levantó las orejas. Escuchó, muy quieto… y luego mordisqueó una hoja de trébol. {rabbit:face happy} Ahora tú. {canvas:sunset 0.6 35s} {fox:face normal} Así que Zorro se sentó. {fox:live hold} Levantó las orejas, cerró los ojos y escuchó. [slowly] {sfx:leaves} Una hoja susurró. {rabbit:pulse} {sfx:brook} Un arroyo borboteó. Y entonces, sin ruido, {owl:enter} Búho bajó volando a una rama del viejo árbol. {owl:live} Parpadeó, miró a su alrededor, bostezó… se quedó dormido… y abrió un ojo, y luego los dos. {sfx:hoo} Uh-uh, dijo. Buenas noches. {fox:live resume} Zorro abrió los ojos con una sonrisa y meneó la cola. {fox:face happy} {fox:hearts} [happily] El bosque llevaba todo el rato hablando.

leaves.prompt: a single dry leaf rustling in a light breeze

brook.prompt: a little brook bubbling over stones, a short soft burble

hoo.prompt: one soft, friendly distant owl hoot, two gentle notes
